turns.user: Pull the strategy lab's edges report for this week and tell me which pattern has the best edge.
turns.reply:
I can't pull that one: the strategy lab — backtests, replays and research reports — needs **Max**, and this account is on **Pro** (just read it from candle_execution_status, along with its 50 bps fee). It isn't among my tools and there's no other route to it, so there's no edges report for me to read this week, and I won't guess which pattern wins.

What I can do on Pro instead: work an edge hypothesis directly from live data — the Hacc signal tape (new_ticker, confluence, large_move, dormancy, distribution, deployer, intra_book, kol_mention), token histories and wallet results — and build the case by hand from what tracked wallets actually did. That's observation, not a backtest: no recorded-price replay, no fill modelling, so treat anything from it as a lead to paper-trade rather than a measured edge.

If you want the lab's own report, switch the account to Max (or run it from the console on a Max profile) and I'll read the output with you.
